findings.source_quote: Ten thousand angels, He could have summoned south,
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri mstari huu bila kuongeza mwelekeo wa kijiografia: “Angeweza kuita malaika elfu kumi,”
findings.translation_quote: Angeliweza kuwaita malaika elfu kumi kutoka kusini,

findings.source_quote: Because He treasured us, an atonement for our sin / He made when He bled and died there to make us His kin!
findings.suggested_fix: Hifadhi maana kwamba alifanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu alipomwaga damu na kufa, ili kutufanya kuwa jamaa zake. Kwa mfano: “Kwa sababu alitutunza, alifanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu / Alipomwaga damu na kufa pale, ili atufanye kuwa jamaa zake!”
findings.translation_quote: Kwa sababu alituthamini, alifanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu / Alipovuja damu na kufa pale ili atufanye kuwa jamaa zake!
